purpose: Say that something exceeds a stated comparison point.
keywords: The roads were more crowded than expected.
This time we need even more preparation than last time.
The summit was colder than I had imagined.
restrictions: The comparison can be a quantity, person, or expectation.
mistake: Use 以上 for an inclusive numerical threshold without comparative emphasis.

segments.role: Say that something exceeds a stated comparison point. N / plain clause + 以上に

examples.translation: The roads were more crowded than expected.
